problems.explain: a is across from A and b from B, so sin B/28 = sin 87°/35, and sin B = 28 × sin 87° ÷ 35 ≈ 0.7989. sin⁻¹(0.7989) ≈ 53.0255°, which is 53° to the nearest degree. (The supplement 180° − B also has this sine, but with a ≥ b, B is no bigger than A, so it would leave no room for the triangle.) So B ≈ 53°.
